title: Hedyotis diffusa Suppresses Colitis-Associated Colorectal Cancer via Inhibition of the IL-17A-IL-17RA Axis and NF-kappaB Signaling.
authors: Hou, Yun-Jhu; Hsiang, Chien-Yun; Lo, Hsin-Yi; Chang, Fang-Chia; Ho, Tin-Yun
one_liner_zh: 研究中药白花蛇舌草通过抑制IL-17A/NF-kB信号通路治疗结肠炎相关结直肠癌，仅涉及蛋白-小分子对接，无蛋白质-DNA互作或TF-DNA结合建模，与本课题无关。
abstract: Chronic inflammation-driven colorectal cancer (CRC) is critically mediated by interleukin-17A (IL-17A)-dependent immune responses and nuclear factor-kappaB (NF-kappaB) signaling, which promote immune cell infiltration and tumor progression. In this study, the anti-tumor efficacy and molecular mechanisms of a standardized extract of Hedyotis diffusa Willd. (HD) and its constituent, ferulic acid (FA), were investigated using an azoxymethane/dextran sulfate sodium (AOM/DSS)-induced colitis-associated CRC mouse model. HD and FA treatment markedly alleviated colitis, reduced tumor number and size, improved survival, and attenuated histopathological damage. Transcriptomic analysis revealed significant modulation of immune-related pathways, with prominent suppression of IL-17A and NF-kappaB signaling. Molecular docking demonstrated binding of FA to IL-17A at Pro59 and Arg101, suggesting potential disruption of the IL-17A/IL-17RA interaction. Consistently, both HD and FA reduced immune cell infiltration, downregulated IL-17A production, and inhibited NF-kappaB activation in colonic tissues. Collectively, these findings demonstrated that HD exerted protective effects against inflammation-associated CRC through targeting the IL-17A/IL-17RA axis and downstream NF-kappaB signaling, providing mechanistic insight into IL-17A-centered immunomodulation in colorectal tumorigenesis.
abstract_zh: 慢性炎症驱动的结直肠癌（colorectal cancer, CRC）关键由白细胞介素-17A（interleukin-17A, IL-17A）依赖性免疫反应和核因子-kappaB（nuclear factor-kappaB, NF-kappaB）信号通路介导，这些机制促进免疫细胞浸润和肿瘤进展。本研究利用氧化偶氮甲烷/葡聚糖硫酸钠（azoxymethane/dextran sulfate sodium, AOM/DSS）诱导的结肠炎相关CRC小鼠模型，探讨了标准化白花蛇舌草（Hedyotis diffusa Willd.，HD）提取物及其成分阿魏酸（ferulic acid, FA）的抗肿瘤功效和分子机制。HD和FA处理显著缓解结肠炎，减少肿瘤数量和大小，改善生存率，并减轻组织病理学损伤。转录组分析揭示免疫相关通路的显著调节，其中IL-17A和NF-kappaB信号通路受到明显抑制。分子对接显示FA与IL-17A在Pro59和Arg101位点结合，提示可能破坏IL-17A/IL-17RA相互作用。一致地，HD和FA均减少结肠组织中的免疫细胞浸润，下调IL-17A产生，并抑制NF-kappaB激活。综合而言，这些发现表明HD通过靶向IL-17A/IL-17RA轴及其下游NF-kappaB信号通路，对炎症相关CRC发挥保护作用，为结直肠肿瘤发生中以IL-17A为中心的免疫调节提供了机制性见解。
